title: SF-CON-PORTAL-PLACEMENT
description: Server-side deployment binding of one portal to one tenant and cell (ADR-0007 D-1). Loaded by the API host from deployment configuration, never from a request. Citizen RequestContext tenant/cell come from this record; the citizen identity comes from CMP-004. PREPROD/PRODUCTION are excluded until the owner accepts ADR-0007 for production (D-4).

portal_id.description: Stable deployment identifier. Not a tenant name and not shown to users.

environment.description: PREPROD and PRODUCTION require owner acceptance of ADR-0007 and a Contract Change Request.

environment_label.description: Present when the placement serves synthetic SAMPLE_LAB data only.
